raj: Starting quick pre-launch readiness check for tonight's change window. Key items: pin model v2.4.1, canary 5%, run smoke suite, freeze merges T-30. Who's on deploy?

emma: I'm on deploy. Kicking off smoke now. Smoke suite path: ci/release/234.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: Change window scheduled 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Trigger: release/2.4.1. Canary target: 5% -> dedicated-gpu-pool-a.

lee: Oncall here — I'll watch infra and errors. Escalation rules: latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% => rollback.

maria: Docs/notes are staged. Release notes draft: feature X, perf tuning, fallback routing. Rollback steps included.

raj: Quick explicit rollback plan: pin traffic back to model v2.4.0, disable canary, scale down new nodes, notify customers if >30m. Who can approve emergency unfreeze?

emma: I can approve emergency unfreeze up to 23:30 UTC if a hotfix is needed.

lee: If we see memory leak patterns revert within 10m and open incident channel #incidents. I'll prepare runbook snippets.

raj: Running smoke locally: ```./scripts/smoke-check.sh --env=staging --suite=latency``` Output tail: "tail_latency=85ms, errors=0/1000"

emma: smoke results: OK — P95 120ms, tail 85ms, no regressions. Uploading logs to artifacts/release/2001234567.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: reached 5% at 22:05 UTC. Monitoring window started.

maria: Finalizing changelog: "changelog: add feature X; fix: tokenization edge case" — ready for prod publish.

raj: Plan: promote to 100% if stable at +20m. Freeze merges at 21:30 UTC (T-30). Post-launch checks at +15m and +30m.

lee: Affirmative. I'll post alerts if any SLO breaches.

emma: Monitoring model quality evals now. If hallucination regression > 3% revert.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: 100% complete at 22:28 UTC. No alerts during monitoring window.

raj: Great — closing this readiness thread. If anything pops, open a follow-up in #postmortems and tag me. :tada:
